doc: Waits for CD sync to complete; if the sync result is "no intr" (2), issues a CdlPause CdControl command writing into the global CD position buffer D_800814B8, then converts that position to an integer (sector count) via CdPosToInt.

globals.name: D_800814B8
globals.decl: unsigned char D_800814B8[16]; /* CD sector position buffer (CdlLOC-ish), size>8 so it addresses via %hi/%lo not $gp under -G8; exact size unconfirmed beyond >8 */

calls: CdControl(unsigned char com, unsigned char *param, unsigned char *result)
